summary: 30-year-old man from Chicago fell ~10 feet at the top of the gulley near the First/Second Flatiron Trail, fracturing his lower leg; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group and City of Boulder Open Space and Mountain Parks rangers stabilized him, packaged him in a stretcher and carried him to an ambulance at the Bluebell Shelter; AMR transported him to a Boulder area hospital (~3.5-hr rescue; BCSO case 21-3867)
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, City of Boulder Open Space and Mountain Parks, American Medical Response, Boulder County Sheriff's Office
